stem.en: As a water wave passes a floating cork, the cork bobs up and down but does not travel with the wave. What does this show?
stem.et: Kui veelaine läbib ujuvat korki, liigub kork üles-alla, kuid ei liigu koos lainega. Mida see näitab?

label.en: The wave carries the water along with it
The wave transfers energy without carrying the medium along with it
label.et: Laine kannab energiat ilma keskkonda endaga kaasa kandmata

label.en: The cork is too light to be moved by the wave
label.et: Kork on lainest liigutamiseks liiga kerge
